description: Defines the class 'pseudo_random_generator_sequence' which generates pseudo-random sequences based on TS38.211 specifications, including methods for stepping the sequence and generating bits in parallel.

classes.name: pseudo_random_generator_sequence
classes.description: A class that generates pseudo-random sequences using internal states x1 and x2, with methods for stepping and generating multiple bits.

methods.name: get_max_step_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of bits that can be generated in a single step.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Advances the sequence by a specified number of bits, returning the sequence bits.

methods.name: step64
methods.description: Generates and steps the sequence 64 bits at a time.

methods.name: get_x1
methods.description: Returns the current state of x1.

methods.name: get_x2
methods.description: Returns the current state of x2.
